subject: NovaCorp SIG/QnA: evidence handoff & demo availability
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.n@novacorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: NovaCorp SIG/QnA: evidence handoff & demo availability

Hi Alice — thanks again for taking the call intro last week. As discussed, we'd like to run a short SIG/CAIQ Q&A and a focused demo of the Dedicated deployment model so your security team can validate controls and see runtime observability.

Proposed agenda (30–45m):
- 5m: quick intros & scope confirmation
- 15m: SIG/CAIQ question review (areas NovaCorp flagged: auth, key mgmt, logging)
- 15m: demo of Dedicated console (networking, audit logs, token-level cost traces)
- 5m: next steps / evidence handoff plan

Could you confirm which of these days/times work for your team?
- Wed Dec 8, 10:00–10:45 PST
- Thu Dec 9, 14:00–14:45 PST

Action items we need ahead of the call:
- Your prioritized SIG/CAIQ question list (mark ones requiring artifact samples)
- Any compliance contacts we should include (procurement / legal if redlines expected)

I've attached a short "ask list" spreadsheet that maps common SIG questions to the artifacts we usually provide — should speed the handoff.

Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-sig-ask-list.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Alice Nguyen <alice.n@novacorp.com>

Cc: security-team@novacorp.com
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 11:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: NovaCorp SIG/QnA: evidence handoff & demo availability

Thanks Camila — Wed 12/8 10:00 PST works for our security team (we'll have 3 people: myself, Marcus Holt, and our cloud security lead). We can also do Thu 12/9 if anything changes.

I've attached our initial prioritized SIG export (PDF) and flagged items where we need sample logs, KMS configuration, and data residency statements. We also like the proposed agenda.

Two quick notes:
1) For artifacts that contain logs, we need a redacted sample and a brief note on retention ranges.
2) On the demo, if you can show where audit events surface in the console (token creation, model rollouts, and model fallback events), that would be ideal.

Alice Nguyen
Security Program Manager, NovaCorp
alice.n@novacorp.com

Hi Alice — Ben from Solutions/SE here, looping in for artifacts and logging questions. We'll prepare:
- Redacted log samples showing token-level traces and request latency fields (JSON lines)
- A short note on our retention defaults and how customers can configure longer retention on Dedicated
- KMS integration guide and a screenshot of the key management page in Private deployments

Camila: will you own the demo side? Kimberly — can you confirm whether the dedicated demo cluster will have model fallback events in the sample timeline?

- token creation events, rollout timestamps, and model fallback entries in the audit stream
- sample KV cache hit/miss metrics

Subject: Re: NovaCorp SIG/QnA: evidence handoff & demo availability — post-call notes & artifacts

Great session today — thanks everyone for the time. Quick summary and next steps: 

Summary (from today's 12/8 call):
- We walked through prioritized SIG sections: authentication, key management, logging/audit, deployment boundaries.
- Demo showed Dedicated console: audit event stream (token create, model rollout, fallback) + KV cache metrics.
- Agreed that NovaCorp needs: redacted audit logs (1 week sample), KMS config screenshots & HSM integration note, and a short runbook for log exports.

Action items (owners / ETA):
- Ben Carter: deliver redacted JSON log samples and retention note — ETA 2026-12-10 EOD.
- Camila Reyes: upload the annotated CAIQ mapping spreadsheet with NovaCorp flags (reference attached) — ETA 2026-12-11.
- Kimberly Park: share demo recording + ephemeral credential link (already uploaded) — credential link expires 2026-12-15.
- Marissa Cole: open HubSpot ticket and attach all artifacts; she'll send the DocuSign link for the confidentiality agreement if needed.

Attachments delivered with this thread: redwood-sig-ask-list.xlsx, session-recording-20261208.mp4 (recording, hosted link), redwood-demo-credentials.txt

If anything missing or if the security team wants deeper logs (longer retention window or additional event types), reply-all and we'll schedule a follow-up walk-through.

Thanks — Camila
